name: ExpediaGroup GitHub org (general)

name: vrbo-main-link-scraper
what_it_holds: Commercial-flavored ("Bitbash") lightweight Vrbo link/ID extractor outputting JSON {listing_url, property_id, location, title, scraped_at}; claims 1,200 links/minute, 98%+ success. Single commit, no license specified, 0 stars, sample JSON in README only (one record).
why_useful: Only gives listing IDs/URLs, not price/amenity data - a discovery step, not a supply/price panel by itself. Low value unless paired with a detail scraper like Edioff/vrbo-scraper.
